scope: Tiny same-reference fixture, installed BLAST2.17.0; query-only tblastn-fast versus tblastx
interpretation: The same alignment raw score receives different bit scores and Evalues between programs. Query-only translation is not a drop-in statistical equivalent.
Effective search space for the exact intended-frame example is equal; do not invent a universal sixfold Evalue adjustment.
Keep program-reported scores and significance with method labels, and inspect shared alignment coordinates/sequences separately from taxonomy differences.
Invalid-composition frame warnings and zero effective search spaces are retained; original reads remain in denominators.
source_limit: Interpretation rests on captured executable output; no claim that the cited historical paper specifies this installed version.
